data.body: S2 6cd0 plan-review: BLOCK x3 — E2 (run_id provenance unspecified), G6 CRITICAL (plan named runner.py:259/:719 but not the seam; :259 is inside FakeRunner.run which has no instance config, reaching config only via req.config), T8 CRITICAL (schema trace_id descriptions still say 'Langfuse trace id when tracing is enabled', contradicting the new emitted semantics). All three verified against the tree. Remediated: dropped run_id entirely (no distinct consumer; trace_id identifies the run), named req.config.trace_id as the seam with operations.py:209-212 provenance and the dataclasses.replace/max_output_cfg survival note, added both schema files to Scope with description updates and two new ACs. Propagated the run_id removal to the epic, 26ae and 98b6.
